summary: Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF (HYPG, Nasdaq) filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026 disclosing that its sponsor, Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, amended the Amended and Restated BitGo Custodial Services Agreement to add BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. as an additional custodian for a portion of the Trust's HYPE holdings. Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. remains primary custodian; the existing arrangement is unaffected. BitGo Trust will hold HYPE in a segregated custodial account, is OCC-authorized, and will process sponsor-fee withdrawals on instruction. No allocation amount was determined. This is a routine custody-services contract, not a special situation.
